issues.where: lower-left night-side outline and foreground ring crossing (pair-02 crop D)
issues.what: The disk edge reads as a hard dark cutout, and the crossing ring is broader and more visible than the faint diffuse streak in the target.
issues.fix: Soften the dark silhouette and reduce the foreground ring opacity and edge contrast, leaving only the target's faint broken glints.

issues.where: top limb and illuminated right flank (pair-02 crops C, E, F, G and I)
issues.what: The top rim is more etched and even; down the right flank the atmospheric wash looks thicker and more cyan, with a darker strip separating the lower-right surface from the outer rim.
issues.fix: Soften the top rim peak, pull back the cyan wash on the lit flank, and blend the lower-right atmosphere into the surface so it does not read as a separate shell.

issues.where: upper-left moon (pair-02 crop B shows the lit edge)
issues.what: The moon is slightly smaller vertically and rounder-looking, with less crater relief and a darker, softer left terminator.
issues.fix: Match the reference disk silhouette and phase gradient, and restore crisp crater relief on the lit face without over-sharpening the edge.

issues.what: A small dark notch interrupts the center of the otherwise matching flare.
issues.fix: Remove the notch and keep the target's uninterrupted white core and existing flare rays.

issues.where: main storm and left-side cloud filaments (pair-02 crops A and H)
issues.what: The brightest storm ridges look slightly smoother and heavier, and some of the finer adjacent filaments are less distinct.
issues.fix: Restore the fine filament contrast and taper the broadest highlights while preserving the matched storm placement.

issues.where: right-side background ring and adjacent starfield (pair-02 crops G and I)
issues.what: The outbound ring strands are a little more sharply drawn and the nearby star points read slightly heavier than in the reference.
issues.fix: Reduce the ring-strand and star-point contrast locally while preserving the arc and existing star placement.

issues.where: central dark vortex and upstream spiral (pair-04 crops A and G)
issues.what: Fine blue streaks fill the storm eye and tighten its rim. The target has a quieter, darker center with a softer transition to the spiral.
issues.fix: Suppress the fine streaks in the center and ease the local contrast at the inner rim without flattening the outer spiral.

issues.where: foreground cloud ridge and its shadow from lower left to lower right (pair-04 crops D, E, H and I)
issues.what: Fine backlit wisps and the shadow texture beneath the ridge are slightly softer, particularly along the thinning right-hand tail.
issues.fix: Restore selective strand detail on the bright edges and subtle texture in the cast shadow without raising the black floor.
